answer: One concrete defense bonds every agent identity to a non-refundable resource stake that only compounds with honest tenure. Like felling timber to raise a cabin, spinning up a fresh identity costs real capital upfront, and the standing it earns accrues slowly epoch by epoch from one dawn to the next. A sybil swarm would need a thousand full stakes posted at once, so the quill that signs each attestation always traces back to sunk cost no throwaway bot farm can cheaply counterfeit.
